rationale:
Decision: split into four children, two new nodes plus two reuses of comparator-accepted declarations with byte-identical frozen types.

Why split. Steps 3–4 of the supplied proof re-derive Simon's stationary monotonicity identity (Ch. 4, 3.2–3.6) at a centre z ∈ L: cutoff fields X_ρ = φ(|x − z|/ρ)(x − z), differentiation of I and J under the integral sign, constancy of J and the limit ρ ↓ 0. That identity, on closed balls and at an arbitrary centre z, is already comparator-accepted as Submission.dtc_cone_monotonicity_identity (node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.cone-a1.monotonicity_identity-a1, candidate 4d61ba7a, about 490 Lean lines). As a leaf, this node could use only its listed prerequisite imrep_univ_tangent_starProjection_aemeasurable, so it would have to redo that analytic derivation. Listing the accepted identity as a reused child lets the proof follow Simon's own printed argument (proof of 7.3.1, chapter-07.txt lines 352–360: constant density ratio plus "the monotonicity formula 3.6 of Ch. 4" give D^⊥r = 0 a.e.). The remaining new work consists of two separate, reusable obligations:
- ball_scaling (supplied step 1). Pure measure theory for an arbitrary measure: L-translation invariance and n-homogeneity give μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(z)) for z ∈ L.
- centre_tangency (supplied steps 2–4 for one centre). Stationarity and a constant closed-ball ratio at z give x − z ∈ T_x μ-a.e. This is the centre-z generalization of the accepted centre-0 lemmas dtc_cone_radial_tangency and stationary_imrep_radial_tangency_of_ball_ratio. Those lemmas do not apply at z ≠ 0: translating R would need an IMRep push-forward, which the library lacks.

Mapping to the supplied proof.
- Step 1 → ball_scaling. It is stated for an arbitrary measure. With c = μ(B̄_1(0)) = μ(B̄_1(z)) (by translation) it is exactly μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = cρ^n.
- Step 2 (finiteness of c; a.e. measurability of x ↦ p_x, which the supplied proof calls load-bearing) → tangent_projection_measurable and step 1 of centre_tangency. tangent_projection_measurable is the accepted imrep_univ_tangent_starProjection_aemeasurable, already this node's dependency; it is listed so that centre_tangency can consume it.
- Step 3 (first-variation identity, Simon 3.2–3.4) and its integration (Simon 3.5–3.6) → monotonicity_identity.
- Step 4 (J ≡ 0, hence p_x(x − z) = x − z μ-a.e. for each z ∈ L) → centre_tangency applied to the conclusion of ball_scaling.
- Step 5 (countable family and closure) stays in the parent assembly.

Parent assembly. For z ∈ L, ball_scaling supplies exactly the hypothesis of centre_tangency, so ∀ᵐ x, p_x(x − z) = x − z.
- z = 0 ∈ L gives p_x x = x.
- For the countable D ⊆ L of step 5, a basis b_1, …, b_k of L suffices (finite, hence countable). From x − b_i ∈ T_x and x ∈ T_x we get b_i ∈ T_x, so the subspace T_x contains span{b_i} = L. Closedness of T_x, needed for a merely dense D, is then not used.
- Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff turns L ⊆ T_x into p_x v = v.
The following assembly of the exact frozen parent type compiles with axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound:
theorem Submission.dimred_cs_spine_tangent_of_invariant_measure : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = R.measure A) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x ∧ ∀ v ∈ L, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v := by
  intro P n R L _hn hstat htrans hhom
  have hz : ∀ z ∈ L, ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure,
      (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z := fun z hz =>
    Submission.dimred_cs_st_tangent_sub_of_ball_ratio P n R z hstat
      (Submission.dimred_cs_st_closedBall_measure_scaling P n R.measure L htrans hhom z hz)
  let b := Module.finBasis ℝ L
  filter_upwards [hz 0 L.zero_mem, ae_all_iff.2 fun i => hz (b i) (b i).2] with x hx0 hxb
  rw [sub_zero] at hx0
  refine ⟨hx0, fun v hv => Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.2 ?_⟩
  have hxT : x ∈ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.1 hx0
  -- `b i = x - (x - b i) ∈ Tₓ`
  have hbT : ∀ i, ((b i : L) : Euclid P) ∈ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x := fun i => by
    have h1 := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.1 (hxb i)
    simpa using (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).sub_mem hxT h1
  -- `L = span (range b) ≤ Tₓ`
  have hLT : L ≤ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x := by
    have h : Submodule.map L.subtype (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range b)) ≤
        approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact hbT i
    rwa [b.span_eq, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] at h
  exact hLT hv

subproblems.title: The approximate tangent plane field of an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P is a.e. measurable
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) (an integer multiplicity triple in U = ℝ^P) with weight μ = R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M. For x ∈ ℝ^P let T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x (the approximate tangent n-plane of M at x where it exists, {0} otherwise) and p_x the orthogonal projection onto T_x. Then x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. measurable as a map ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) (Borel σ-algebra).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure
subproblems.natural_proof:
Reuse note (context, not part of the numbered proof): this child is the comparator-accepted declaration Submission.imrep_univ_tangent_starProjection_aemeasurable of DAG node root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1.tangent_projection_aemeasurable-a1 (status accepted, candidate commit 74a7d9117386066688fb3586d8463c5a8900db71, isolated comparator passed). Its frozen type is byte-identical to the lean_statement above, so the controller reuses that node and creates no new node. It is already the resolved dependency of the selected node (parent handoff: sibling tangent_projection_measurable); it is listed here so that the new sibling centre_tangency can consume it. Use in the selected node: centre_tangency step 3 needs x ↦ p_x to be R.measure-a.e. measurable, so that the defect integrand |(x − z) − p_x(x − z)|²/|x − z|^{n+2} is a.e. measurable and its vanishing lower integral forces it to vanish a.e. (parent step 2, "This is load-bearing").

Accepted proof:
Source: Simon uses the approximate tangent planes T_xV of V = v(M,θ) as measurable data in all integrands of Ch. 4 (e.g. |D^⊥r|² in the monotonicity identity Ch. 4, 3.6, chapter-04.txt lines 290–312, used in parent step 3), and Ch. 6, 3.1 (chapter-06.txt lines 733–753) requires ξ to orient the approximate tangent spaces "in an H^n-measurable way". This measurability is implicit in the parent's step 3; it is proved here from Definition Ch. 3, 1.4 (chapter-03.txt lines 77–86).

Notation. M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, μ = R.measure, H^n = μHE[n], ν := H^n⌞M, T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x := orthogonal projection onto T_x (starProjection), b_{x,r}(y) := r^{-1}(y − x) (blowUpMap x r).
0. Degenerate case n = 0. In the definition of approxTangentPlane, the chosen subspace in the "if" branch has finrank n = 0 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt includes finrank Q = n), hence equals ⊥, and the "else" branch is ⊥. So x ↦ p_x is constant and measurable. Assume n ≥ 1 from now on.
1. Local finiteness. θ ≥ 1 on M, so ν(K) ≤ μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K (R.locallyIntegrable_mult with U = ℝ^P).
2. Tangent planes exist a.e. By R.orients there is, for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M (hence, as μ ≪ ν, for μ-a.e. x), an n-plane Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q; at such x the defining "if" of approxTangentPlane holds, so HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x T_x and dim T_x = n. Let G be the set of these x; μ-a.e. x lies in G.
3. Test functions. χ(t) := max(1 − t, 0); for u ∈ ℝ^P let f_u(y) := χ(|y|²)⟨u, y⟩². f_u is continuous with support in the closed unit ball, i.e. f_u ∈ C_c(ℝ^P).
4. Integrals over planes. For every n-plane Q: ∫_Q f_u dH^n = c_n |p_Q u|², with c_n := ∫_{ℝ^n} χ(|z|²) z_1² dz ∈ (0, ∞).
 Proof. Choose an orthonormal basis τ_1,…,τ_n of Q and the linear isometry ι : ℝ^n → ℝ^P, ι(z) = Σ z_iτ_i, with range Q. Then H^n⌞Q is the push-forward of H^n on ℝ^n, which is Lebesgue measure L^n (Mathlib Isometry.map_euclideanHausdorffMeasure and EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume). Hence, with a_i := ⟨u, τ_i⟩,
 ∫_Q f_u dH^n = ∫ χ(|z|²)(Σ_i a_i z_i)² dL^n(z) = Σ_{i,j} a_i a_j ∫ χ(|z|²) z_i z_j dL^n(z).
 For i ≠ j the reflection z_i ↦ −z_i is a linear isometry of ℝ^n, preserves L^n and |z|, and changes the sign of z_iz_j, so the integral vanishes; for i = j the coordinate swap z_i ↔ z_1 shows ∫ χ(|z|²) z_i² dL^n = c_n. So the integral equals c_n Σ_i a_i² = c_n|p_Q u|². Finally c_n < ∞ (continuous integrand with compact support) and c_n > 0 (the integrand is continuous, ≥ 0 and positive at (1/2, 0, …, 0)).
5. Blow-up integrals are continuous in x. Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) and r > 0, and let Φ_{f,r}(x) := ∫_{b_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n (the integral occurring in HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt). Since b_{x,r} is a translation followed by the dilation by r^{-1}, H^n(b_{x,r}(B)) = r^{-n}H^n(B) for all B (translation invariance and Mathlib euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀), and as in a change of variables Φ_{f,r}(x) = r^{-n} ∫_M f(r^{-1}(y − x)) dH^n(y). Let spt f ⊆ closedBall(0, R_f). For x in ball(x_0, 1) the integrand is bounded by sup|f| and vanishes unless y ∈ closedBall(x_0, 1 + rR_f), a set of finite ν-measure; it is continuous in x for each y. By dominated convergence Φ_{f,r} is continuous, hence Borel measurable.
6. Limits. For x ∈ G, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x T_x applied to f_u along r_k := 1/(k+1) → 0⁺ gives Φ_{f_u, r_k}(x) → ∫_{T_x} f_u dH^n = c_n|p_x u|² (step 4). Since μ-a.e. x lies in G, the function x ↦ c_n|p_x u|² is the μ-a.e. limit of the measurable functions Φ_{f_u, r_k}, hence μ-AEMeasurable (Mathlib aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae'); dividing by c_n > 0, x ↦ |p_x u|² is μ-AEMeasurable for every u ∈ ℝ^P.
7. Polarization. p_x is self-adjoint and idempotent, so ⟨p_x u, w⟩ = ⟨p_x u, p_x w⟩ = (|p_x(u + w)|² − |p_x(u − w)|²)/4. Hence x ↦ ⟨p_x u, w⟩ is μ-AEMeasurable for all u, w.
8. Assembly. With the standard orthonormal basis e_1,…,e_P, p_x = Σ_{a,b} ⟨p_x e_a, e_b⟩ · L_{ab}, where L_{ab} ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P), L_{ab}(v) := ⟨e_a, v⟩e_b (indeed p_x v = Σ_b ⟨p_x v, e_b⟩e_b and v = Σ_a ⟨e_a, v⟩e_a). A finite sum of μ-AEMeasurable scalar functions times constant continuous linear maps is μ-AEMeasurable for the Borel σ-algebra of L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P); hence x ↦ p_x = (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection is AEMeasurable with respect to R.measure.
proof_key_steps: n = 0: the tangent-plane field is identically ⊥; assume n ≥ 1.
For f_u(y) = max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u,y⟩², ∫_Q f_u dH^n = c_n|p_Q u|² with c_n > 0 (isometry to ℝ^n and coordinate symmetries).
x ↦ ∫_{b_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n is continuous (rescaling + dominated convergence); at a.e. x it tends to ∫_{T_x} f dH^n as r = 1/(k+1) → 0.
Hence x ↦ |p_x u|² is a.e.-measurable; polarization and a basis expansion give AEMeasurable x ↦ p_x.

subproblems.title: Stationary monotonicity identity on closed balls at an arbitrary centre (Simon Ch. 4, 3.6)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with μ = R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M, and assume v(M, θ) is stationary in ℝ^P: R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support. Let p_x be the orthogonal projection onto T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x. Then for every z ∈ ℝ^P and 0 < σ ≤ ρ, with closed balls B̄_t(z), μ(B̄_σ(z))/σ^n + ∫_{B̄_ρ(z) \ B̄_σ(z)} |(x − z) − p_x(x − z)|²/|x − z|^{n+2} dμ(x) = μ(B̄_ρ(z))/ρ^n, as an identity in [0, ∞] (division by ENNReal.ofReal(t^n), lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal of the integrand).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → ∀ (z : Euclid P) (σ ρ : ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → R.measure (closedBall z σ) / ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n) + ∫⁻ x in closedBall z ρ \ closedBall z σ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - z) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - z‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure = R.measure (closedBall z ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)

Reuse note (context, not part of the numbered proof): this child is the comparator-accepted declaration Submission.dtc_cone_monotonicity_identity of DAG node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.cone-a1.monotonicity_identity-a1 (status accepted, candidate commit 4d61ba7a2f0f196353bbfd45451335c9f03a2b1f, isolated comparator passed). Its frozen type is byte-identical to the lean_statement above, so the controller reuses that node and creates no new node. In the accepted proof below, "child 1" is the accepted declaration Submission.dtc_cone_tangentProjection_aemeasurable (node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.cone-a1.tangent_projection_measurable-a1), a prerequisite already contained in that accepted candidate, so no sibling dependency is needed here. Use in the selected node: the parent's step 3 (testing stationarity with X_ρ = φ(|x − z|/ρ)(x − z) to obtain d/dρ(ρ^{−n}I(ρ)) = ρ^{−n}J'(ρ), Simon Ch. 4, 3.2–3.4) and the integration of that relation (Simon Ch. 4, 3.5–3.6) are exactly this identity at centre z; sibling centre_tangency (step 4) uses it in this integrated form, as Simon does in the proof of 7.3.1 (chapter-07.txt lines 352–360).

Accepted proof:
Sources. Simon Ch. 4, 3.1–3.6 (chapter-04.txt lines 212–312; Simon's B_ρ are closed balls), applied with U = ℝ^P, R = ∞ and centre z. This is step 3 of the parent proof, with its step 0 for integrability. It is formalized in SimonGMT as Chapter04.RectifiableVarifold.IsStationaryIn.satisfiesStationaryMonotonicity. Uses sibling tangent_projection_measurable (child 1).

Notation. M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ν := Hⁿ⌞M, μ = R.measure = ν.withDensity θ. T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x and p_x is its orthogonal projection. r(x) := |x − z| and B̄_t := closedBall(z, t). For x ≠ z, D^⊥r(x) := (x−z)/r − p_x((x−z)/r). Then |D^⊥r|²r^{−n} = |(x−z) − p_x(x−z)|²/|x−z|^{n+2} and |D^⊥r| ≤ 1.

0. Preliminaries.
(a) For compact K, μ(K) = ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞, by locallyIntegrable_mult with K ⊆ ℝ^P = U (K is closed, hence Borel).
(b) μ ≪ ν. Since θ ≥ 1 on M, a property holds μ-a.e. iff it holds ν-a.e.
(c) By `orients`, for ν-a.e. x some Q satisfies HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q. By the definition of approxTangentPlane and HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique, at such x we have HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x T_x and dim T_x = n.
(d) x ↦ p_x is ν-AEMeasurable (child 1), hence μ-AEMeasurable by (b).
(e) Let X ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^P; ℝ^P) and div_M X(x) := trace(p_x∘DX(x)).
 - div_M X is μ-AEMeasurable by (d).
 - |div_M X(x)| ≤ P·‖DX(x)‖: expand the trace in an orthonormal basis and use ‖p_x‖ ≤ 1.
 - Since ‖DX‖ is continuous with compact support, (a) makes div_M X μ-integrable.
 - R.firstVariation X = ∫_M θ·div_M X dHⁿ = ∫ div_M X dμ (integration against a measurable ℕ-valued density).
 So the hypothesis is the genuine identity ∫ div_M X dμ = 0 for every X ∈ C¹_c.

1. Radial test fields (Simon 3.1–3.3). Let γ ∈ C¹(ℝ) with γ' = 0 on (−∞, δ] for some δ > 0 and γ = 0 on [T, ∞).
- X(x) := γ(r(x))(x − z) is C¹ with compact support; it equals γ(0)(x − z) on B_δ(z).
- For x ≠ z, DX(x)u = γ(r)u + γ'(r)⟨(x−z)/r, u⟩(x−z).
- For μ-a.e. x (those with dim T_x = n), trace(p_x) = n. Also, by Pythagoras, trace(p_x∘(u ↦ ⟨(x−z)/r, u⟩(x−z))) = ⟨p_x(x−z), (x−z)/r⟩ = r|p_x((x−z)/r)|² = r(1 − |D^⊥r|²).
- Hence div_M X = nγ(r) + rγ'(r)(1 − |D^⊥r|²). At x = z both sides equal nγ(0).
- By (e): n∫γ(r)dμ + ∫rγ'(r)dμ = ∫rγ'(r)|D^⊥r|²dμ (Simon 3.3).

2. Cutoff (Simon 3.4). Fix ε ∈ (0,1) and a nonincreasing φ = φ_ε ∈ C¹(ℝ; [0,1]) with φ = 1 on (−∞, 1] and φ = 0 on [1+ε, ∞) (e.g. SimonGMT monotonicityCutoff). For t > 0 take γ(r) := φ(r/t) in step 1, and put I(t) := ∫φ(r/t)dμ and J(t) := ∫φ(r/t)|D^⊥r|²dμ (finite by (a)).
- We have rγ'(r) = (r/t)φ'(r/t) = −t∂_t[φ(r/t)].
- ∂_tφ(r/t) = −(r/t²)φ'(r/t) is bounded by (1+ε)sup|φ'|/t and supported in B̄_{(1+ε)t}, uniformly for t in compact subsets of (0, ∞). So differentiation under the integral sign is justified.
- Step 1 then gives nI(t) − tI'(t) = −tJ'(t), i.e. d/dt(t^{−n}I(t)) = t^{−n}J'(t) for t > 0.

3. Squeeze (Simon 3.5, with the prefactors in the correct order). Let 0 < σ < ρ.
- Integrate step 2 over [σ, ρ] and use Fubini (∂_tφ(r/t) ≥ 0): ρ^{−n}I(ρ) − σ^{−n}I(σ) = ∫(∫_σ^ρ t^{−n}∂_tφ(r/t)dt)|D^⊥r|²dμ.
- ∂_tφ(r/t) ≠ 0 only when r/(1+ε) < t < r, and there r^{−n} ≤ t^{−n} ≤ (1+ε)ⁿr^{−n}.
- ∫_σ^ρ ∂_tφ(r/t)dt = φ(r/ρ) − φ(r/σ) ≥ 0, and it vanishes where r ≤ σ (both values are 1).
- Hence ∫r^{−n}(φ(r/ρ) − φ(r/σ))|D^⊥r|²dμ ≤ ρ^{−n}I(ρ) − σ^{−n}I(σ) ≤ (1+ε)ⁿ∫r^{−n}(φ(r/ρ) − φ(r/σ))|D^⊥r|²dμ, and all integrals are finite.

4. Limit ε ↓ 0 (Simon 3.6).
- φ_ε(s) → 1_{(−∞,1]}(s) for every s: for s > 1, φ_ε(s) = 0 once 1 + ε < s. So φ_ε(r/t) → 1_{B̄_t} pointwise, dominated by 1_{B̄_{2t}}, which is μ-integrable by (a).
- Likewise r^{−n}(φ_ε(r/ρ) − φ_ε(r/σ))|D^⊥r|² → r^{−n}|D^⊥r|²·1_{B̄_ρ∖B̄_σ}, dominated by σ^{−n}1_{B̄_{2ρ}}.
- Dominated convergence in step 3, with (1+ε)ⁿ → 1, gives
 ρ^{−n}μ(B̄_ρ) − σ^{−n}μ(B̄_σ) = ∫_{B̄_ρ∖B̄_σ} |D^⊥r|²r^{−n}dμ for 0 < σ < ρ.
- For σ = ρ both sides are 0.

5. Conclusion. On B̄_ρ∖B̄_σ we have x ≠ z and |D^⊥r|²r^{−n} = |(x−z) − p_x(x−z)|²/|x−z|^{n+2} ≥ 0. All quantities are finite and nonnegative. Move σ^{−n}μ(B̄_σ) to the right-hand side and apply ENNReal.ofReal:
- ofReal is additive on nonnegative reals;
- ofReal of the integral of a nonnegative integrable function is the lower integral of ofReal;
- ofReal(μ(B̄_t)/tⁿ) = μ(B̄_t)/ofReal(tⁿ), since μ(B̄_t) < ∞.
This gives exactly
 μ(B̄_σ(z))/ofReal(σⁿ) + ∫⁻_{B̄_ρ(z)∖B̄_σ(z)} ofReal(|(x−z) − p_x(x−z)|²/|x−z|^{n+2}) dμ = μ(B̄_ρ(z))/ofReal(ρⁿ). ∎

subproblems.title: Closed-ball masses of an L-translation-invariant n-homogeneous measure at centres in L
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on (the Borel σ-algebra of) ℝ^P and L ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace. Assume μ((fun x => y + x)⁻¹'A) = μ(A) for every y ∈ L and every Borel A, and μ((fun x => λ • x)''A) = λ^n μ(A) (λ^n read as ENNReal.ofReal(λ^n)) for every λ > 0 and every Borel A. Then for every z ∈ L and every ρ > 0, μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(z)), where B̄_r(c) = closedBall c r.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = μ A) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * μ A) → ∀ z ∈ L, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * μ (closedBall z 1)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source. Step 1 of the parent proof ("Constant ratios at points of L"). It is the scaling computation behind Simon's proof of 7.3.1 (chapter-07.txt lines 352–355: "(ω_nρ^n)^{−1}μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = Θ^n(T, x) for each ρ > 0"), transported by translation to centres z in the spine L of Lemma 7.3.5 (chapter-07.txt lines 410–419, proof "left to the reader"). Notation: B̄_r(c) := closedBall c r = {x : ‖x − c‖ ≤ r}; ρ^n in [0, ∞] means ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^n). Only the two hypotheses on μ are used; μ need not be finite or locally finite.
1. (Translation by −z.) Let z ∈ L and r ∈ ℝ. Since L is a linear subspace, −z ∈ L. For x ∈ ℝ^P we have (−z) + x = x − z, so x ∈ (fun x => (−z) + x)⁻¹'(B̄_r(0)) ⇔ ‖x − z‖ ≤ r ⇔ x ∈ B̄_r(z); that is, (fun x => (−z) + x)⁻¹'(B̄_r(0)) = B̄_r(z). The closed ball B̄_r(0) is a Borel set, so the translation hypothesis with y = −z and A = B̄_r(0) gives μ(B̄_r(z)) = μ(B̄_r(0)).
2. (Dilation by ρ.) Let ρ > 0. Then (fun x => ρ • x)''B̄_1(0) = B̄_ρ(0): if ‖x‖ ≤ 1 then ‖ρx‖ = ρ‖x‖ ≤ ρ; conversely, if ‖y‖ ≤ ρ then y = ρ(ρ^{−1}y) with ‖ρ^{−1}y‖ = ρ^{−1}‖y‖ ≤ 1 (Mathlib Set.image_smul and smul_unitClosedBall_of_nonneg). B̄_1(0) is Borel, so the homogeneity hypothesis with λ = ρ and A = B̄_1(0) gives μ(B̄_ρ(0)) = ofReal(ρ^n)·μ(B̄_1(0)).
3. (Conclusion.) By step 1 with r = ρ, then step 2, then step 1 with r = 1: μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = μ(B̄_ρ(0)) = ofReal(ρ^n)·μ(B̄_1(0)) = ofReal(ρ^n)·μ(B̄_1(z)). ∎

Lean implementation (compiled during decomposition after the frozen contract, in namespace GMT.Ch07 with the contract's opens; #print axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
theorem Submission.dimred_cs_st_closedBall_measure_scaling : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = μ A) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * μ A) → ∀ z ∈ L, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * μ (closedBall z 1) := by
  intro P n μ L htrans hhom z hz ρ hρ
  -- translation by `-z ∈ L`: `B̄_r(z) = (x ↦ -z + x)⁻¹' B̄_r(0)`
  have htr : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (closedBall z r) = μ (closedBall 0 r) := by
    intro r
    rw [← htrans (-z) (L.neg_mem hz) (closedBall 0 r) measurableSet_closedBall]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [mem_closedBall, mem_preimage, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, neg_add_eq_sub]
  -- dilation by `ρ`: `B̄_ρ(0) = (x ↦ ρ • x) '' B̄_1(0)`
  have hsc : (fun x => ρ • x) '' closedBall (0 : Euclid P) 1 = closedBall 0 ρ := by
    rw [Set.image_smul, smul_unitClosedBall_of_nonneg hρ.le]
  rw [htr, htr 1, ← hsc, hhom ρ hρ _ measurableSet_closedBall]
proof_key_steps: −z ∈ L and (x ↦ −z + x)⁻¹'B̄_r(0) = B̄_r(z), so translation invariance gives μ(B̄_r(z)) = μ(B̄_r(0)) for every r.
(x ↦ ρx)''B̄_1(0) = B̄_ρ(0), so homogeneity gives μ(B̄_ρ(0)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(0)) for ρ > 0.
Combining the translation identity at radii ρ and 1 with the dilation identity: μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(z)).

subproblems.title: Constant closed-ball density ratio at z forces x − z ∈ T_x a.e. for a stationary varifold
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with μ = R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M, and z ∈ ℝ^P. Assume v(M, θ) is stationary in ℝ^P: R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support. Assume also μ(B̄_ρ(z)) = ρ^n μ(B̄_1(z)) for every ρ > 0 (closed balls, ρ^n read as ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^n)). Then for μ-a.e. x, p_x(x − z) = x − z, where p_x is the orthogonal projection onto T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x; i.e. x − z ∈ T_x for μ-a.e. x.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (z : Euclid P), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z 1)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source. Steps 2–4 of the parent proof for one fixed centre z, in the form of Simon's printed argument in the proof of 7.3.1 (chapter-07.txt lines 352–360): the normalized ball mass is constant, "(ω_nρ^n)^{−1}μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = Θ^n(T, x) for each ρ > 0. Then by the monotonicity formula 3.6 of Ch. 4, applied to the stationary varifold V_C …, we have D^⊥r = 0 μ_C-a.e. … That is x ∈ T_x spt C for μ_C-a.e. x"; here the centre 0 is replaced by z. The parent's step 3 (testing stationarity with X_ρ = φ(|x − z|/ρ)(x − z), which gives d/dρ(ρ^{−n}I(ρ)) = ρ^{−n}J'(ρ), Simon Ch. 4, 3.2–3.4) and the integration of that relation over [σ, ρ] (Simon Ch. 4, 3.5–3.6, chapter-04.txt lines 215–307) are exactly the sibling monotonicity_identity (Simon 4.3.6 with closed balls and arbitrary centre z, comparator-accepted). It is used below in this integrated form, and the parent's step-4 conclusion (the normal part of x − z vanishes μ-a.e.) follows from it. The same argument at z = 0 is the accepted proof of Submission.dtc_cone_radial_tangency.
Notation. M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, μ = R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ, T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x and p_x its orthogonal projection (starProjection). B̄_t := closedBall z t, a := μ(B̄_1), and for x ∈ ℝ^P d(x) := ofReal(‖(x − z) − p_x(x − z)‖²/‖x − z‖^{n+2}) ∈ [0, ∞). This is the integrand of the sibling identity; for x ≠ z, ‖(x − z) − p_x(x − z)‖/‖x − z‖ = |D^⊥r| in Simon's notation. Hypotheses: (S) R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P; (C) μ(B̄_ρ) = ofReal(ρ^n)·a for every ρ > 0.
1. (a is finite.) B̄_1 is compact and Borel. By withDensity_apply and restrict_restrict, μ(B̄_1) = ∫⁻_{B̄_1} θ d(H^n⌞M) = ∫⁻_{M ∩ B̄_1} θ dH^n, which is ≠ ∞ by the field locallyIntegrable_mult applied to K = B̄_1 ⊆ ℝ^P. So a < ∞.
2. (Normalized ratios.) For ρ > 0, ofReal(ρ^n) ∈ (0, ∞), so by (C), μ(B̄_ρ)/ofReal(ρ^n) = (ofReal(ρ^n)·a)/ofReal(ρ^n) = a.
3. (Measurability.) By the sibling tangent_projection_measurable, x ↦ p_x ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is μ-a.e. measurable. Evaluation (A, v) ↦ A v is continuous on L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) × ℝ^P and x ↦ x − z is measurable, so x ↦ p_x(x − z) is μ-a.e. measurable. Composing with subtraction, the norm, squaring, division by the measurable function x ↦ ‖x − z‖^{n+2} and the measurable map ofReal, d is μ-a.e. measurable; hence it is also μ⌞A-a.e. measurable for every Borel A, since μ⌞A ≤ μ.
4. (The defect vanishes on annuli.) Let 0 < σ ≤ ρ and A := B̄_ρ \ B̄_σ (Borel). The sibling monotonicity_identity, applied to R with (S), centre z and radii σ, ρ, gives μ(B̄_σ)/ofReal(σ^n) + ∫⁻_A d dμ = μ(B̄_ρ)/ofReal(ρ^n). By step 2 this reads a + ∫⁻_A d dμ = a = a + 0, and since a ≠ ∞ (step 1) the summand a cancels in [0, ∞]: ∫⁻_A d dμ = 0. By step 3 and the characterization of vanishing lower integrals of a.e.-measurable functions (Mathlib lintegral_eq_zero_iff'), d = 0 μ⌞A-a.e.; as A is measurable (ae_restrict_iff'), for μ-a.e. x: x ∈ A ⇒ d(x) = 0. Fix such an x with x ∈ A. Then x ∉ B̄_σ, so ‖x − z‖ > σ > 0. ofReal(q) = 0 means q ≤ 0, so ‖(x − z) − p_x(x − z)‖²/‖x − z‖^{n+2} ≤ 0; multiplying by ‖x − z‖^{n+2} > 0 gives ‖(x − z) − p_x(x − z)‖² ≤ 0, hence = 0. So (x − z) − p_x(x − z) = 0, i.e. p_x(x − z) = x − z.
5. (Exhaustion.) For k ∈ ℕ put σ_k := 1/(k + 1) and ρ_k := k + 1, so 0 < σ_k ≤ 1 ≤ ρ_k. Step 4 for every k and the countable intersection of full-measure sets (ae_all_iff) give: for μ-a.e. x, for every k, x ∈ B̄_{ρ_k} \ B̄_{σ_k} ⇒ p_x(x − z) = x − z. Fix such an x. If x = z, then p_x(x − z) = p_x(0) = 0 = x − z by linearity. Otherwise r := ‖x − z‖ > 0; choose k ∈ ℕ with k > max(r, r^{−1}). Then r < k + 1 = ρ_k, so x ∈ B̄_{ρ_k}; and k + 1 > r^{−1} gives σ_k = 1/(k + 1) < r, so x ∉ B̄_{σ_k}. Hence p_x(x − z) = x − z.
Therefore p_x(x − z) = x − z for μ-a.e. x, i.e. x − z ∈ T_x μ-a.e. (Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff). ∎
Remarks. The hypothesis n ≥ 1 is not needed, because the sibling identity holds for every n. The statement is the centre-z generalization of the accepted centre-0 lemmas Submission.dtc_cone_radial_tangency and Submission.stationary_imrep_radial_tangency_of_ball_ratio.

theorem Submission.dimred_cs_st_tangent_sub_of_ball_ratio : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (z : Euclid P), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z 1)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z := by
  intro P n R z hstat hball
  -- Step 1: `a := μ(B̄_1(z)) < ∞`
  have ha : R.measure (closedBall z 1) ≠ ∞ := by
    have h := R.locallyIntegrable_mult (closedBall z 1) (isCompact_closedBall z 1) (subset_univ _)
    rwa [IMRep.measure, withDensity_apply _ measurableSet_closedBall,
      Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_closedBall, Set.inter_comm]
  -- Step 2: the normalized ratio is constantly `a`
  have hratio : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ →
      R.measure (closedBall z ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) = R.measure (closedBall z 1) := by
    intro ρ hρ
    rw [hball ρ hρ, mul_comm, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel_right
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 (pow_pos hρ n)).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
  -- Step 3: measurability of the defect integrand
  have hp : AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z))
      R.measure :=
    (continuous_fst.clm_apply continuous_snd).aemeasurable2
      (Submission.imrep_univ_tangent_starProjection_aemeasurable P n R)
      (aemeasurable_id.sub_const z)
  have hf : AEMeasurable (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal
      (‖(x - z) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z)‖ ^ 2 /
        ‖x - z‖ ^ (n + 2))) R.measure :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp_aemeasurable
      ((((aemeasurable_id.sub_const z).sub hp).norm.pow_const 2).div
        ((measurable_id.sub_const z).norm.pow_const (n + 2)).aemeasurable)
  -- Step 4: the defect over each annulus vanishes
  have hann : ∀ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure,
      x ∈ closedBall z ρ \ closedBall z σ →
      (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z := by
    intro σ ρ hσ hσρ
    have h := Submission.dtc_cone_monotonicity_identity P n R hstat z σ ρ hσ hσρ
    rw [hratio σ hσ, hratio ρ (hσ.trans_le hσρ)] at h
    have hD := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff' (hf.mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self)).1
      ((ENNReal.add_right_inj ha).1 (h.trans (add_zero _).symm))
    have hA : MeasurableSet (closedBall z ρ \ closedBall z σ) :=
      measurableSet_closedBall.diff measurableSet_closedBall
    filter_upwards [(ae_restrict_iff' hA).1 hD] with x hx hxA
    have hxσ : σ < ‖x - z‖ := by
      have h2 := hxA.2
      rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, not_le] at h2
      exact h2
    have h0 : ‖(x - z) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z)‖ ^ 2 /
        ‖x - z‖ ^ (n + 2) ≤ 0 :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.1 (hx hxA)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos (hσ.trans hxσ) _), zero_mul] at h0
    have hnorm := (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 (le_antisymm h0 (sq_nonneg _))
    exact (sub_eq_zero.1 (norm_eq_zero.1 hnorm)).symm
  -- Step 5: the annuli `B̄_{k+1}(z) \ B̄_{1/(k+1)}(z)` exhaust `ℝᴾ \ {z}`
